correctness.rationale: Rooted depth-r truncations model the 1-WL colors on trees. The two-front geodesic witness argument forces at least 2s+1 vertices for a strict split at round s; paths attain floor((n-1)/2). Independently enumerated every nonisomorphic tree for n=2..14 (5,446 total) with a separate partition-refinement implementation, obtaining the claimed extrema in every order. Finite enumeration supplements, not replaces, the induction/peeling argument; the inward matching step is the principal structural proof dependency.
